title: WAL Key-Value Store UTF-8 Framing & Crash Compaction
prompt:
Fix the durability, encoding, and compaction bugs in this Write-Ahead Log (WAL) backed key-value store.

Reported issues:
1. Storing keys or values with multi-byte UTF-8 characters (accented letters, CJK, emoji) corrupts WAL record framing and fails CRC checks upon reopen.
2. Replaying a WAL segment with a torn/truncated trailing write or corrupt trailing CRC crashes `open()` instead of recovering every valid prefix record and truncating the corrupted tail so new writes append cleanly.
3. Partial compaction (`compact({ keepOldest })` where older segments remain uncompacted) drops tombstone records too early, resurrecting deleted keys after reopening the store.

Inspect the codebase and run `node --test test/public.test.ts` as you work.
